findings.location:
In 1627...to the small church of Anwoth.

(paragraph describing his ministry and zeal)
findings.source_quote: His passion was for the conversion of the people, and it is said that he seemed to be always praying, always preaching, always visiting the sick, always teaching and instructing, always writing or studying.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the phrase that renders 'preaching' as 'سچ بولنے' with a phrase conveying 'preaching the gospel' to match the original meaning. For example, change 'سچ بولنے' to 'خوشخبری سنانے/تبلیغ کرنے' while preserving the surrounding HTML and tags.
findings.translation_quote: ...کہا جاتا ہے کہ وہ ہمیشہ دعا گو، ہمیشہ تبلیغ کرنے والا، ہمیشہ بیماروں کے پاس جانے والا، ہمیشہ تعلیم دینے والا اور ہدایت کرنے والا، اور ہمیشہ لکھنے یا مطالعہ کرنے والا نظر آتا تھا۔
